title: Follow a small compiled calculation
description: You can identify function code, static data, and the values used by main.

steps.description: The comment gives a build command. add returns the sum of its two integer arguments.
greeting points to a format string. The globals hold a call count and the most recent result; section labels are explanatory comments, not inspected binary output.

steps.question: What value does add(3, 4) assign to last_result?

steps.description: main increments call_count and prints last_result through greeting. The supplied output reads Result: 7.
